owner_decisions.eyedropper: Click any open viewer; sample working RGB before display transform; preserve parameter alpha.
owner_decisions.grade: Mix remains scalar without picker or RGB expander. Alpha is editable in expanded RGBA. Graduated tracks are linear over existing soft ranges; exact typing remains unclamped by soft travel.
owner_decisions.header: Retain explicit pin, collapse and close controls.
owner_decisions.write: Use revised reference without tabs or render-mode selector; Render uses authored first/last range. Retain transform, LUT and job feedback below the shown controls.
owner_decisions.write_channels: All, RGB, RGBA and Alpha; default All preserves existing behavior. Unsupported movie selections are refused.

acceptance_boundary: Reference assets and owner decisions, not a claim of owner acceptance of the implemented surface.
